title: Three methods for examining the de novo proteome of microglia using BONCAT bioorthogonal labeling and FUNCAT click chemistry
protocol: Seed BV2 cells into 8-well chamber slides or 6-well plates for microscopy and flow cytometry respectively.
Coat 8-well chamber slides with PDL by adding 200 μL of 0.5 mg/mL PDL per well.
Incubate coated slides in a 37°C incubator for at least 1 hour.
Remove PDL from the slides after incubation and wash 3 times with PBS, each time for 3 minutes.
Place washed slides back into the 37°C incubator until ready to use.
Place culture medium and 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA in a 37°C water bath for 10–15 min prior to work.
Remove medium from the culture flask.
Wash cells briefly with 5 mL (T25) or 10 mL (T75) PBS at room temperature.
Remove PBS and add pre-warmed 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA depending on the flask size: 1 mL for T25, 3 mL for T75.
Incubate cells in a 37°C incubator for 3 min.
Tap sides of flask to detach cells; check under microscope to ensure all cells have detached.
If necessary, continue tapping or further incubate for up to 10 min.
Add 1 mL (for T25) or 3 mL (for T75) pre-warmed culture medium to inhibit trypsin.
Collect cells from flask into a 15 mL tube by pipetting.
Centrifuge the tube at 200 × g for 3 min.
Remove medium without disturbing the cell pellet and resuspend in 1 mL fresh culture medium.
Perform cell counts via preferred method.
Seed cells as follows: For microscopy experiments using 8-well chamber slides, seed 25,000 cells/well.
Seed 350,000 cells per well in a 6-well plate.
Thoroughly mix cell suspension before seeding to ensure consistent cell numbers across wells.
Tilt the plates to disperse cells homogeneously without swirling.
Place seeded cells in a 37°C incubator and leave them to grow overnight for 16–20 hours.
Seed BV2 cells on Day 0 at the required density.
Label newly synthesized proteins via AHA incorporation for either 30 min or 4 hours, using appropriate controls (i.e., methionine and/or AHA with anisomycin).
Fix cells or collect proteins at the end of the AHA-labeling period.
Warm culture medium in a 37°C water bath for 10 minutes.
Thaw 0.4 M AHA.
Thaw 0.4 M methionine.
Thaw 10 mM anisomycin if required.
Prepare experimental medium as follows: For 8-well chamber slides, add 3 μL of 0.4 M AHA to obtain a working concentration of 4 mM per 300 μL medium for AHA labeling.
For methionine control in 8-well chamber slides, add 3 μL of 0.4 M methionine per 300 μL medium for a working concentration of 4 mM.

For AHA and anisomycin controls in 8-well chamber slides, add 3 μL of 0.4 M AHA to obtain a working concentration of 4 mM AHA and 1.2 μL of 10 mM anisomycin per 300 μL medium for a working concentration of 40 μM anisomycin.
For 6-well plates, add 10 μL of 0.4 M AHA to reach a working concentration of 4 mM per 1 mL medium for AHA labeling.
For methionine control in 6-well plates, add 10 μL of 0.4 M methionine per 1 mL medium for a working concentration of 4 mM.
For AHA with anisomycin controls in 6-well plates, add 10 μL of 0.4 M AHA plus 4 μL of 10 mM anisomycin per 1 mL medium for a working concentration of 40 μM anisomycin.
Prepare master mix solution (10% in excess) from which appropriate volumes are added to wells.
Remove medium from wells and replace with experimental medium containing either methionine, AHA with anisomycin, or AHA.
Incubate in 37°C incubator for either 30 min OR 4 h depending on desired labeling period.
Warm medium in 37°C water bath.
Remove AHA/methionine/anisomycin-containing medium from wells.
Add 300 μL pre-warmed fresh medium to wells.
For AHA with anisomycin treated cells, add a concentration of 4 mM AHA and 40 μM anisomycin to the fresh medium.
Place back in a 37°C incubator for 10 min.
Remove medium and wash briefly once with PBS.
Remove PBS and add 4% paraformaldehyde prepared in PBS.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Prepare Microscopy FUNCAT blocking buffer during incubation.
Remove paraformaldehyde and wash twice with 1× TBS for 5 minutes each.
Permeabilize and block with Microscopy FUNCAT blocking buffer for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Wash three times with 1× TBS for 5 minutes each.
Prepare click chemistry reaction solution using Invitrogen Click-iT® Cell Reaction Buffer kit and Alexa Fluor 647 alkyne according to the protocol.
Remove the wash solution and add 100 μL click chemistry reaction master mix solution per well.
Shield from light and incubate at room temperature (20°C–25°C) on a gentle rocker (20 rpm) for 1 h.
Wash 3 times with 1× TBS for 5 min each at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Add 1:20 Alexa fluor 488 phalloidin to visualize the cell outline and incubate for 30 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Wash 3 times with 1× TBS for 5 min each.
In the second wash, add 1:10,000 DAPI (1 μg/mL stock) to label cell nuclei.
Remove frame of the well-chambers and gently tap to remove excess liquid.
Add 3 drops of DAKO mounting medium.
Coverslip and seal.
Quantify FUNCAT fluorescence for each individual cell using IMARIS software.
Create a cell surface using the phalloidin channel (green) in IMARIS.
Apply appropriate cell surface and threshold values to capture the whole cell.
Separate touching cells by using the ‘Cut Surface’ function if necessary.
Ensure all cells are properly separated.
Export data as an Excel file.
Select the point to be cut using 'SHIFT + click'.
Separate cells using the ‘cut surface’ IMARIS function.
Export data to an excel file using ‘average values’ in the Details tab.
Extract fluorescence intensity in the FUNCAT channel per cell from the excel table.
Quantify cells with one nucleus (visualized using DAPI).
Exclude cells without DAPI that are likely burst or lysed during click chemistry and washing process.
Warm medium in a 37°C water bath.
Remove AHA/methionine/anisomycin-containing medium and add pre-warmed fresh medium.
Add anisomycin into fresh medium for AHA with anisomycin-treated cells.
Place back in a 37°C incubator for 10 min.
Remove medium from wells.
Wash briefly once with PBS.
Remove PBS.
Add 500 μl 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA to each well; incubate at 37°C for 3 min.
Add 500 μl fresh medium to each well; collect total 1 ml cell suspension into respective 1.5 ml tube.
Keep cells on ice.
Centrifuge tubes at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Carefully remove supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1 ml ice cold PBS to wash.
Centrifuge tubes at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant; resuspend the pellet in 500 μL 4% PFA.
Incubate at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 15 min.
Prepare Flow cytometry FUNCAT blocking buffer during the 15 min incubation.
Centrifuge tubes at 1,000 × g for 5 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant; resuspend the pellet in 1 mL TBS.
Pause point: Leave at 4°C overnight (16–20 h) if necessary.
Centrifuge tubes at 1,000 × g for 7 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 200 μL Flow cytometry FUNCAT blocking buffer.
Incubate for 15 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C) with rotation to avoid cell settling.
Centrifuge tubes at 1,000 × g for 5 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant; resuspend the pellet in 1 mL 1× TBS.
Prepare click chemistry reaction solution using Invitrogen Click-iT® Cell Reaction Buffer kit and Alexa Fluor 647 alkyne.
Calculate your required master mix volume for 50 μL per sample plus 10% excess (i.e., for 12 samples, make a total of 660 μL master mix).
Use click chemistry reaction solution within 15 min of preparation.
Centrifuge tubes at 1,000 × g for 5 minutes.
Carefully remove supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 50 μL click reaction solution per tube.
Shield from light and incubate at room temperature (20°C–25°C) with rotation for 1 hour.
Centrifuge tubes at 1,000 × g for 5 minutes.
Carefully remove supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL 1× TBS.
Repeat this wash step.
Centrifuge tubes at 1,000 × g for 5 minutes.
Carefully remove supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 200 μL TBS + 1% BSA.
Pipette into flow cytometry tube.
Create a second gate using FSC-H and FSC-W parameters to remove cell doublets from the population analyzed.
Create a third gate using SSC-H and SSC-W to further remove doublets from the population.
Use the methionine control sample (FUNCAT negative background) to set background threshold for FUNCAT positive fluorescence.
Quantify equal numbers of cells for each sample (e.g., 20,000 cells per sample).
Warm medium in a 37°C water bath and label 1.5 mL tubes (one per well).
Set a centrifuge to cool down to 4°C.
Prepare Radio-Immunoprecipitation Assay (RIPA)-based lysis solution master mix.
Remove AHA/methionine/anisomycin-containing medium.
Add 1 mL of pre-warmed fresh medium per well.
For AHA with anisomycin-treated cells, include anisomycin in the fresh medium.
Incubate at 37°C for 10 minutes.
Remove the medium after incubation.
Add 1 mL ice-cold PBS to each well.
Place plates on ice and keep cells cold until protein isolation is complete.
Use a cell scraper to detach cells from wells.
Transfer detached cells into 1.5 mL tubes using a pipette.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant carefully without disturbing the pellet.
Add 100 μL of RIPA-based solution per tube.
Sonicate to lyse the cells.
Repeat sonication if necessary until sample is not sticky.
Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Collect supernatant carefully and transfer into new 1.5 mL tubes.
Discard the pellet.
Denature proteins by incubating at 95°C for 10 minutes.
Separate samples into aliquots (20–30 μL each), plus one 12 μL aliquot for BCA Assay.
Store aliquots at −80°C until ready to continue.
Dilute 12 μL sample 1:3 in RIPA-based solution for protein concentration quantification.
Prepare 8‒10 standards using the provided 2 μg/μL BSA with a serial dilution in RIPA-based solution.
Use RIPA-based solution as blank for the assay.
Mix Pierce BCA reagent A:B at 50:1 ratio for 200 μL per well.
Add 10 μL sample, standard, or blank to wells in a 96 well plate.
Add 200 μL Reagent A:B mix to each well.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min protected from light.
Read absorbance at 562 wavelength using a plate reader after incubation.
Create a standard curve and use linear regression to calculate the protein concentration of each sample from average optical densities (OD).
Multiply by dilution factor (here: 3) to obtain final concentrations.
Perform click chemistry reaction using Click-iT® Protein Reaction Buffer Kit and Biotin Alkyne prepared before you begin.
For each sample, add 10–20 μg protein into a protein-free 1.5 mL tube.
Add 1× RIPA solution up to 20 μL for the reaction.
Mix Reaction Buffer with biotin alkyne to a working concentration of 40 μM.
Add 50 μL of the Reaction Buffer/biotin-alkyne mix to each sample.
Vortex for 3 seconds.
Add 10 μL Milli-Q water per sample and vortex.
Add 5 μL copper (II) sulfate (CuSO4) and vortex.
Add 5 μL Buffer Additive I and vortex to mix.
Wait for 2–3 minutes without exceeding 5 minutes before the incubation step.
Add 10 μL of Additive 2 and vortex to mix.
The solution will turn bright orange.
Rotate end-over-end for 20 minutes at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Add 300 μL methanol and vortex briefly.
Add 75 μL chloroform and vortex briefly.
Add 200 μL Milli-Q water and vortex briefly.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 14,000 × g.
Carefully discard the supernatant (orange upper aqueous phase).
Repeat wash step with 450 μL methanol and vortex briefly.
Centrifuge samples for 5 minutes at 14,000 × g.
Discard the supernatant carefully.
Cover open tubes with lint-free tissue and place them in a fume hood until methanol evaporates (15 minutes to 1 hour).
Alternatively, leave covered tubes on benchtop overnight (16 to 20 hours) for evaporation.
Close tubes once methanol has fully evaporated and store at -20°C.
Resuspend samples in 10 μL of RIPA buffer.
Add 2.5 μL of 4× Laemmli buffer to the resuspended sample.
Denature the samples at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Load 2 μL of protein ladder and samples into a 4%–15% pre-cast gel.
Run the gel at 90 V until samples enter the gel, then increase voltage to 120 V.
Transfer samples to low fluorescence PVDF membrane using semidry transfer method or any suitable Western blot transfer method for mixed to high molecular weight proteins.
Wash the membrane briefly in Milli-Q water.
Incubate membrane in REVERT 700 Total Protein Stain for 5 minutes on a gentle rocker.
Wash the membrane twice with REVERT wash solution for 30 seconds each.
Briefly wash the membrane twice in Milli-Q water.
Read the stained membrane using Odyssey Li-Cor at 700 wavelength.
Remove Milli-Q and add REVERT Reverse for 8 min, rocking gently.
Wash briefly with Milli-Q twice.
Wash once with TBS to equilibrate the membrane at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Block with BioRad EveryBlot Blocking Buffer for 15 min on a rocker.
Add 1:20,000 IRDye 800CW Streptavidin in EveryBlot Blocking Buffer.
Incubate at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 30 min on a rocker.
Wash with TBS three times for 10 min each.
Visualize in the 800 nm channel.
Quantify the fluorescence intensity using appropriate software and background subtraction.
